profile.headline: Technomancer, Full Snack Devourer, Renaissance Woman
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I enjoy creating elegant and efficient solutions to complex problems, learning experiences, and long walks on the continuous delivery pipeline.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Created a single-page web application for controlling the simulation of the new GPS space vehicle constellation and ground control stations, accommodating more robust functional tests.
-Lead a team implementing automated functional end-to-end testing and continuous delivery of GPS-OCX mission software.
-Worked with Defense Digital Service to implement modern DevOps processes on GPS-OCX, utilizing current continuous delivery technologies, and helped overcome adoption challenges.
-Automated configuration of nearly un-automatable legacy Windows infrastructure using Chef.
-Created REST web services producing GPS data for consumers across the globe.
-Created a high-performance simulation of the OCX monitor stations which track ephemerides (position and orbit) of GPS space vehicles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed and implemented scalable web services, providing functionality critical to revenue-generating user workflows, such as reservations, hotel details, and guest accounts, servicing up to 30 million requests/day.
-Converted a legacy EJB RMI system into a service-oriented architecture, increasing maintainability and scalability.
-Designed and developed various enhancements, such as localization of user-facing data, real-time performance statistics, dynamic and static user-facing content provider system, integration with business-to-business systems.

positions.title: Advanced Development Intern
positions.description:
-Researched and developed prototypes for innovative user interfaces, such as head-tracking for a perspective-aware interface and a multi-touch screen interface that is now ubiquitous in self-checkout systems.
-Designed and developed hardware, as well as interfaced with manufactured hardware.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: -Developed automated tests for a multi-platform client/server geospatial data management system.
